hero.title: Nuts, bolts, screws — ready to pack.
hero.body: Nuts, bolts, screws, and nails for fabrication, construction, and maintenance stores. Grade, size, and finish on the ticket — not a mixed bag from three mills.

why.title: We sell a matched lot, not a mixed handful.

fit.title: Thread that matches the nut
fit.body: Bolts and nuts are gauged as a pair so a site crate does not mix two mills on one joint.

trace.title: Grade-marked on the head
trace.body: 8.8, 10.9, and stainless lots stay identified from bag to bin, not lost on a shared pallet.

floor.title: Packed the way stores issue them
floor.body: Count, kilogram, or set packing so a contractor can order like a store, not like a catalogue essay.

industries.title: Six sectors — same sizes, every month.

process.title: From enquiry to your site
process.lede: Four clear steps — from your size list to a counted lot leaving our Gandhinagar bay.

steps.title: Send the size list
steps.body: Diameter, length, grade, finish, and quantity — or a drawing reference. That is enough to return a rate.
steps.imageAlt: Assorted fasteners sorted by size for a packing list enquiry

steps.title: Matched as pairs
steps.body: Bolts and nuts are gauged together. Grade is marked on the head so a store bin does not mix two mills on one joint.
steps.imageAlt: Hex bolt and matching nut gauged as a pair with grade on the head

steps.title: Counted before dispatch
steps.body: Every bag and crate is counted in Gandhinagar. The packing list must match the lot before it is sealed.
steps.imageAlt: Workers counting and labelling fastener bags in the packing bay

steps.title: Depart from our bay
steps.body: Labelled crates leave Gandhinagar for your site, shop, or plant — the same counted lot, ready to issue on arrival.
steps.imageAlt: Packed fastener crates leaving the Hakimi Fastners workshop bay

infrastructure.title: Threading, finishing, and despatch under one roof.
infrastructure.body: Bolts are headed and rolled, nuts are tapped, nails are drawn, and orders leave counted.

cta.title: Tell us the sizes you refill every month.
cta.body: Name, phone, and a short note are enough. We will call you back with a counted lot — not a catalogue essay.
